id.description: Stable ID, unique across catalog.json 'records'. Safe to use as an external primary key.

kind.description: Free-text record type, e.g. vst-body-proof, universal-termination-proof, calibration-negative-result, interrupted-no-artifact.

claim_status.description: See organization/README.md '#how-to-read-claim_status' for the controlled vocabulary and how to interpret each value; do not treat any 'checked-*' value as unconditionally 'proved' without reading 'distinctions'.

worker.description: job dir name under claude-resume/ or pi-reviews/ that produced this record.

dependencies.description: Other record IDs this one builds on.

source.description: Optional: pins/hashes of the real-world source (coreutils/gnulib commit, file sha256).

proof_statement.description: Optional: the exact Coq/Lean theorem signature, transcribed from the authoring worker's own REPORT.md/receipt log, when the record is proof-shaped.

assumptions.description: Optional: the axiom/assumption set the theorem depends on, as printed by that worker's own Print Assumptions / #print axioms pass.

receipts.description: Named compiler/tool receipts (see artifacts.jsonl for the full flat index).

prior_or_superseded.description: Optional: what this record replaces or corrects.

distinctions.description: The single most important field for correct citation: states what the record does NOT establish, in the terms the project itself uses (witness vs universal, finite vs theorem, safety vs functional, etc.).

actual_times.description: Real clock/receipt-timestamp windows, never estimated or invented.
